# Accordion

> A group of Disclosures where opening one can close the others. Great for FAQs.

`<slab-accordion>` · Disclosure · built on `group of <details>`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/accordion/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/accordion.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-accordion exclusive>
  <slab-disclosure label="Shipping">…</slab-disclosure>
  <slab-disclosure label="Returns">…</slab-disclosure>
</slab-accordion>
```

Each item is a [Disclosure](disclosure.md), documented over there. The APG's accordion puts each header in a heading, so give each Disclosure a `heading-level` that fits the page, such as 3 under an `<h2>`.

## Keyboard

| Key          | What it does                                                   |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tab          | Moves to the next summary, through any open content before it. |
| Enter, Space | Opens or closes the focused Disclosure.                        |

## Elements

### `<slab-accordion>`

Import `slab-elements/accordion.js` to register it.

A group of Disclosures with no visual styles, where opening one can close the others.

A `name` would do that for `<details>` in the same tree, but each Disclosure's is in a shadow root of its own. So Accordion does it instead, from the "toggle" each Disclosure dispatches. Disclosures are found by class rather than by tag name, so your subclass of Disclosure can be named anything.

Disclosures are independent unless `exclusive` is set. When it is and more than one is open, the first one open is kept, the way a `<details>` inserted open beside one of the same `name` is closed. So a Disclosure added later, open, is closed if one is already open.

There are no arrow keys. The APG makes them optional for an accordion, and each summary is already in the Tab order, with its content between it and the next. Arrows would be a second, less familiar way to do the same thing.

#### Attributes

| Name        | Type      | Default | Description                                     |
| ----------- | --------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `exclusive` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether opening a Disclosure closes the others. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type         | Description |
| --------- | ------------ | ----------- |
| (default) | `Disclosure` |             |
